reciprocal.into: P096 — Let the many become one — and be increased by one
reciprocal.why: P096 presents Whitehead's formula of many becoming one; P153 borrows his descriptions of becoming to reflect on one's contribution to an unfolding situation.

notes: P153 (p1o, 2026-10-20): single P096 -> P153 reciprocal proposed (one record, one direction); P096 is p1t, released. No new concept pages needed: 'The many become one', 'Creative advance', 'Mattering' and 'Participate in the world's becoming' already list P153.
